faqSubtitle: Common questions about listing and managing projects on Pronix.
faq1Question: How do I list a new project on Pronix?
faq1Answer: Submit your project through the developer portal with documentation, floor plans, and pricing. Our team reviews and publishes within agreed timelines.
faq2Question: What fees does Pronix charge developers?
faq2Answer: Fees are disclosed during onboarding based on project size and services selected. There are no hidden charges for inventory management or buyer reservations.
faq3Question: Can I manage inventory and pricing myself?
faq3Answer: Yes. You control unit availability, pricing updates, and reservation status in real time through the developer dashboard.
faq4Question: How are co-ownership shares structured legally?
faq4Answer: Co-ownership listings use dedicated SPVs with shares recorded in the Albanian land registry, following the same legal framework as investor co-ownership.
faq5Answer: Pronix manages investor-facing communications, reporting, and distribution workflows while you retain control over project delivery and sales strategy.
faq6Question: Can I offer both full sale and co-ownership units?
faq6Answer: Yes. You can list full-sale units alongside co-ownership shares on the same project with separate availability and pricing per channel.
faq7Question: When will tokenized listings be available?
faq7Answer: Tokenized listings are planned for Q3 2026, extending the same SPV structure with smaller entry points and secondary trading.
